name: Boat Goes Binted

boost.name: Binted Navigation
effect: Advance up to 2 spaces.
HIT: Your opponent discards a card at random.
AFTER: Draw a card.
description: 「Boat Goes Binted」是Gigi在Minecraft直播中帶動的經典迷因，這張牌體現了她擅長復活老迷因、製造混亂的特質。高速低攻、附帶干擾效果，象徵迷因的快速傳播與不可預測性。

name: GG Fister

boost.name: GG Energy
effect: +2 Power.
HIT: Push the opponent 1 space and gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 靈感來自Gigi的經典名言「GG stands for GIGI!」和出道介紹詞「The Fister」。近距離強力打擊，命中後取得先手權，展現她直接了當、充滿自信的個性。

name: Chaser Instinct

boost.name: Relentless Pursuit
effect: Advance up to 3 spaces.
BEFORE: Close 1 space.
HIT: Draw a card.
description: 呼應她官方設定的「追獵者（Chaser）」身份。這張牌強調追擊與壓制，透過接近對手並抽牌來建立節奏優勢，體現她憑直覺追蹤目標的天賦。

name: Gremlin Trick

boost.name: Gremlin Shenanigans
effect: Both players discard a card at random.
HIT: You may return this card to your hand instead of discarding it.
description: 忠實呈現Gigi的「Gremlin（搗蛋鬼）」性格。這張干擾牌讓雙方隨機棄牌，但她能回收此牌繼續騷擾，就像她總是想到新點子來捉弄周圍的人。

name: Brainrot Wave

boost.name: Synaptic Overload
effect: +3 Guard.
HIT: The opponent discards cards from the top of their deck equal to the damage dealt.
description: 源自她與Cecilia Immergreen被稱為「腦腐二人組（Brainrot Duo）」的粉絲愛稱。此牌透過牌組破壞來模擬「腦腐」的擴散效果，代表這對組合的招牌混亂能量。

name: Gi Murin!

boost.name: Morning Star
effect: Add the top card of your deck to your Gauge.
AFTER: Move up to 2 spaces.
AFTER: If you are at range 1 from the opponent, gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 以Gigi自創的打招呼方式命名。全遊戲最高速的攻擊，雖然威力極低，但能快速建立資源與位置優勢，象徵她活力充沛、總能以驚人速度展開行動的風格。

name: CCGG MADNESS

boost.name: Brainrot Duo
effect: Strike.
You may add a copy of a card from your discard to your hand.
HIT: You may return 1 card from your Gauge to your hand.
AFTER: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 致敬Gigi與Cecilia的聯合3D LIVE及原創歌曲。作為雙人組合技，此牌兼具速度與靈活性，命中後可回收資源並搶佔先機，重現舞台上兩人的絕妙默契。

name: CHAOS THEORY

boost.name: Chaos Emergence
effect: Both players shuffle their hands into their decks and draw 4 cards.
When you would discard cards from your hand during this Strike, your opponent discards that many cards at random instead.
description: 將Gigi獲獎無數的「混沌」特質發揮到極致的大招。發動時雙方重洗牌庫，徹底打亂局勢，完美詮釋她不可預測、隨時能顛覆戰局的混沌能量。

name: ABOVE BELOW

boost.name: Melody of Freedom
effect: Gain 2 life.
Draw a card.
Ignore Guard.
HIT: You may spend any amount of Gauge for +1 Power per Gauge spent this way.
description: 以Gigi的出道單曲命名。這張牌代表她自由奔放的靈魂，無視防禦並可消耗計量條增傷，如同她的歌聲一樣穿透力十足且充滿變化。

name: The Fister

boost.name: One Punch
effect: +3 Power.
Stun Immunity.
HIT: Your opponent discards their entire hand.
description: 來自Gigi出道自我介紹中的傳奇台詞。這是最強的近距離終結技，雖然消耗巨大，但命中能清空對手手牌，正如這句台詞帶給觀眾的衝擊力一樣震撼。
